d:
Yah Naturally Creamy grin pasta bachchon aur bare sabhi ko pasand aayega. ghar ke besik ingridients se bani No Mayo, No Sauce, No Maida, Naturally Creamy, Kids Friendly resipi. agar kuchh heldi aur svadisht khana chahte hain to ye grin pasta jarur banaeeye. bachchon ke tiphin, sham ke snaik ya halke dinar ke lie ye parphekt chais hai.
Ingredients for Green Pasta
Namak - Salt - 1 + ¼ tsp
Tel - Oil - 2 tsp
Pasta - Pasta - 1 cup
Chini - Sugar - 1 tsp
Palak - Spinach - 70-80g
Hari mirch - Green Chilli - 1 tsp
